# The Concrete Factory (كونكريت فاكتوري)

> Building better spaces with concrete. Decorative, architectural and industrial concrete: floors, walls, countertops, sinks, fire pits and seating.

Based in Amman, Jordan. Service area: All of Jordan. The site is available in English and Arabic.

## Services
- [Industrial floors](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/industrial-floors)
- [Interior concrete floors](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/interior-floors)
- [Stamped concrete](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/stamped-concrete)
- [Exposed aggregate](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/exposed-aggregate)
- [Terrazzo](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/terrazzo)
- [Architectural concrete walls](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/walls)
- [Concrete countertops & islands](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/countertops)
- [Concrete sinks & basins](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/sinks)
- [Fire pits & built-in seating](https://sanaddmour-byte.github.io/concretefactory/en/services/fire-pits-seating)
